title: Compact hover summary, layered axes, and performance-first chart tokens
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Time-series canvases are becoming slower for dashboards that mount many small charts (metrics feed). Current hover popovers are large, reflow the layout, and request expensive DOM updates for each mousemove. Axes rendering is rigid: multiple layers (grid lines, axis ticks, overlay scales) are painted as full DOM/SVG stacks which complicates batching and prevents reuse across small multiples. Goal: Create a compact hover summary component and standardized axes layering approach that reduces per-frame cost, uses tokenized styles from the design system, and maintains WCAG-compliant keyboard and screen-reader behavior. Deliverables: 1) compact hover summary UI (single-line summary + compact sparkline preview) with token-driven spacing/colors; 2) axis layer spec that separates static layers (grid, y-axis labels) from dynamic layers (series strokes, hover indicators) to enable targeted re-rendering; 3) performance guidelines (downsampling, offscreen rendering, event throttling) and a reference implementation (canvas-first with accessible HTML fallback). Acceptance criteria: - Hover summary opens within 40ms of pointerenter in 90th percentile in local perf harness - No layout shift when summary appears (CLS~0) - Keyboard focus on chart exposes same summary via Enter/Space and announces to SR a succinct line (e.g., "Metric: 12.3, delta +4.1%") - Designs express tokens as CSS variables and match token names in tokens/ charts mapping - Docs include example code and link to ENG PR for runtime optimizations

2026-02-22 - PK (PM): Suggested adding a compact mode toggle for small-multiples dashboard where space is limited. Marking as scope for initial implementation if easy to expose.

2026-02-25 - AM: Accessibility review (internal): recommend live region "aria-live=polite" for hover summary announcements; require keyboard activation and clear focus trap avoidance. Also require color contrast check for compact token set. Added contrast test screenshots to design doc.

2026-02-26 - JL (Eng): Prototype PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4282. Prototype implements layer separation via two canvas elements and exposes a minimal DOM summary. Observed 2.1x reduction in repaint cost on local benchmark with 12 small charts.

2026-03-01 - AM: Design review with component library: minor copy edits; reduced padding in summary and increased label weight to improve legibility at small sizes. Requested tokens: --chart-compact-gap, --chart-legend-weight, --chart-summary-bg.
2026-03-03 - JL: Added perf guidance to PR and included LTTB downsampling example. Requesting design approval for final token names and hover microcopy. Moving to In Progress on Linear.

Document fallback paths for on-prem where OffscreenCanvas isn't available. Provide small-multiples tokens for 'compact' and 'default' variants.
